findings: Nine arm/world stages were selected. Only the transition world admitted competing model artifacts after an initial numeric-literal rejection. Its three arms executed measurements and independently accepted their first submitted conclusions at all 13 calibration/prospective/held-out points. The other six stages were unexecuted, not hidden-test failures or passing cases.

Transport made four executable proposals in two delivered calls; independent point replay agreed with the native arithmetic, but all four proposed responses contradicted admitted calibration observations. Two proposals matched the three zero-control observations but failed the other two. This is an observed model-fit/specification failure; the retained evidence does not identify whether structure, coefficients or interpretation caused it.

Potential made four proposals rejected as ALGEBRAIC_OTHER before any point execution. Their exact parser cause and raw source are not retained; do not guess, reconstruct source or classify unreached hidden points as reasoning failures. Transition had two initial ALGEBRAIC_NUMERIC_LITERAL rejections, then two admitted artifacts.

All 15 logical/HTTP calls delivered successfully with 60672 reported tokens, no unknown usage and no provider, capacity or truncation failure. Delivery stability does not establish mathematical or scientific improvement.

On the only independently graded world, the native-forecast control used two action calls and 5850 action tokens, versus direct review four/12897 and evidence guidance three/10179. With the same allocated world-generation prefix these were four/16317, six/23364 and five/20646 calls/tokens. Equal correctness with more guidance inference does not demonstrate a guidance advantage.

The frozen report marks two cost-matched pairs whose post-generation stages never executed; they are equal shared-prefix charges, not graded matched comparisons. Preserve that report unchanged. Zero independently graded task pairs meet the realized-inference matching criterion. Correct matching applicability in a subsequent version; never retroactively alter this epoch.

All three final research graphs remain INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Correct point predictions did not uniquely distinguish the generated model identities. No live counterexample-driven scientific regeneration occurred; the direct arm's regeneration request was denied because the modeled family was not refuted. Do not infer mathematically inequivalent hypotheses from distinct source digests.

Five actual single-use isolated R3B measurements retained candidate/experiment/model commitment and observation custody. Source integrity and all three fixtures' termination/cleanup were verified. No generated model was executed as host code and no NYX general shell, network, production, credential or device authority was added.
assessment.nextGeneralIntervention: Keep the simpler native-forecast workflow as the experimental baseline, not a promoted universal winner. First reproduce a model-parameter fitting failure and a coarse parser-diagnostic failure on separate development data. Investigate bounded exact fitting of model-authored bases/structure against admitted observations, with rank/ambiguity/residual evidence and independent replay, rather than model-only guessing of rational coefficients. Do not supply exposed world formulas or answer-specific templates. Fix cost-matching applicability under a new report version. Then freeze fresh structural families with identical-tool/strong simpler controls and charge fitting/search/repair compute before any capability promotion.
